# uptimeify_im_outbound_integration (Resource)

An Incident Management outbound integration: forwards incident events to Slack (incoming webhook or the Uptimeify Slack app), Microsoft Teams, Discord, Mattermost, Google Chat, Jira, Linear, PagerDuty (Events v2), Opsgenie or a generic webhook. Incident Management must be active for the organization. URLs, tokens, keys and header values are secrets the API never returns, so they are write-only here; `has_*` tells whether one is stored. A stored secret cannot be cleared by removing it from the configuration (the API keeps it); replace the integration instead. `slack_app` posts through a Slack workspace that an org admin connected in the Uptimeify UI (OAuth); Terraform cannot connect one, it only references it by `workspace_id`. Import with the numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "teams_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "jira_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Post every sev1/sev2 incident event of the platform team to a Microsoft Teams channel.
resource "uptimeify_im_outbound_integration" "teams" {
  name               = "Platform Teams"
  type               = "teams"
  team_id            = 7
  filter_severities  = ["sev1", "sev2"]
  webhook_url_wo     = var.teams_webhook_url
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}

# Open a Jira issue per new incident (the server default event_kinds for jira).
resource "uptimeify_im_outbound_integration" "jira" {
  name         = "Jira OPS"
  type         = "jira"
  email        = "bot@example.com"
  base_url     = "https://example.atlassian.net"
  project_key  = "OPS"
  api_token_wo = var.jira_api_token
}

variable "linear_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "webhook_signing_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Post sev1 incidents to a Slack channel through the Uptimeify Slack app. The workspace is connected
# once in the Uptimeify UI (Slack OAuth); its id is shown there. sev1 incidents also get their own
# private channel.
resource "uptimeify_im_outbound_integration" "slack_app" {
  name                          = "Slack #incidents"
  type                          = "slack_app"
  workspace_id                  = 3
  channel_id                    = "C0123ABCD"
  filter_severities             = ["sev1"]
  incident_channel_min_severity = "sev1"
  incident_channel_private      = true
}

# Open a Linear issue per new incident.
resource "uptimeify_im_outbound_integration" "linear" {
  name           = "Linear ENG"
  type           = "linear"
  linear_team_id = "9cfb482a-81e3-4154-b5b9-2c805e70a02d"
  event_kinds    = ["incident_created"]
  api_key_wo     = var.linear_api_key
}

# Signed generic webhook: every delivery carries X-Webhook-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the body).
resource "uptimeify_im_outbound_integration" "signed_hook" {
  name               = "Signed webhook"
  type               = "webhook"
  webhook_url_wo     = "https://hooks.example.com/uptimeify"
  signing_secret_wo  = var.webhook_signing_secret
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 200 characters, no surrounding whitespace.
- `type` (String) `slack`, `slack_app`, `teams`, `discord`, `mattermost`, `googlechat`, `jira`, `linear`, `pagerduty_v2`, `opsgenie` or `webhook`. Changing it replaces the integration.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `action_links` (Boolean) `webhook`: the payload of an open incident carries signed `actions.resolveUrl` (and `actions.acknowledgeUrl` until acknowledged), valid 24 hours, usable without an Uptimeify account by anyone who can read the payload. Default `false`.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `opsgenie`/`linear`: API key, required. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.
- `api_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `jira`: API token, required. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.
- `base_url` (String) `jira`: site URL, https only, required.
- `bearer_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `webhook`: sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.
- `channel_id` (String) `slack_app`: Slack channel id (starts with `C` or `G`), not the channel name, required.
- `email` (String) `jira`: account email, required.
- `event_kinds` (List of String) Events to forward: `incident_created`, `acknowledged`, `severity_changed`, `status_changed`, `comment`, `resolved`. Unset = all, except `jira`, where the server stores `["incident_created"]`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the stored list.
- `filter_severities` (List of String) Only these severities, `sev1` to `sev4`. Unset = all.
- `filter_team_ids` (List of Number) Only incidents of these teams (of the organization). Unset = all.
- `headers_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `webhook`: extra request headers. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes, then replacing the stored set (unset = remove all).
- `incident_channel_min_severity` (String) `slack_app`: incidents of this severity or worse (`sev1` to `sev4`) also get their own Slack channel, archived on resolve. Unset = off.
- `incident_channel_private` (Boolean) `slack_app`: create that incident channel as a private channel (needs the bot scope `groups:write`). Only takes effect with `incident_channel_min_severity`. Default `false`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Default `true`.
- `linear_team_id` (String) `linear`: id (UUID) of the Linear team issues are created in, not the team key, required.
- `minimal_payload` (Boolean) `slack`/`teams`/`discord`/`mattermost`/`googlechat`: the message carries only severity, title, event kind and link (no team, status, comment text, values or actor). Default `false`.
- `project_key` (String) `jira`: project key, required.
- `read_only` (Boolean) `slack_app`: card without action buttons, for stakeholder channels. Default `false`.
- `routing_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `pagerduty_v2`: integration routing key, required. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change to resend every `*_wo` value.
- `signing_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `webhook`: HMAC key, at least 16 characters. Every delivery then carries `X-Webhook-Signature`, the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.
- `team_id` (Number) Owning team; unset = organization-wide (needs an org admin).
- `thread_comment_sync` (Boolean) `slack_app`: replies of linked users in the thread of an incident card are stored as timeline comments (needs the Events subscription of the Slack app). Default `false`.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) `slack`/`teams`/`discord`/`mattermost`/`googlechat`/`webhook`: target URL (public http(s)), required. Write-only: sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes.
- `workspace_id` (Number) `slack_app`: id of a Slack workspace connected to the organization (connected in the UI), required.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `has_api_key` (Boolean) Whether an Opsgenie or Linear API key is stored.
- `has_api_token` (Boolean) Whether a Jira API token is stored.
- `has_bearer_token` (Boolean) Whether a bearer token is stored.
- `has_headers` (Boolean) Whether custom headers are stored.
- `has_inbound_token` (Boolean) `jira`: whether the back channel from Jira is switched on (managed outside Terraform).
- `has_routing_key` (Boolean) Whether a PagerDuty routing key is stored.
- `has_signing_secret` (Boolean) Whether a webhook signing secret is stored.
- `has_webhook_url` (Boolean) Whether a webhook URL is stored.
- `id` (String) Numeric integration id.
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptimeify_im_outbound_integration.jira 21
```
